title: flow42: replicate flow29 (CL M5 aggressor imbalance reversal) on the independent year 2024-10 .. 2025-10, plus an incremental test of flow beyond the price move; issue 310
before_registration: No outcome computed on 2024-10 .. 2025-10. Before this file: Databento cost quote ($28.27 for the full window), the monthly trade download, and synthetic self-checks (flow29.selfcheck unchanged; H2 on a price-only model gives D_inc about 0 while H1 is negative: 20 seeds mean -0.3 pp, SE 0.3 pp; H2 on a flow-driven model gives D_inc < 0 with CI below 0; bin edges causal). The flow29 year (2025-10 .. 2026-10) outcomes are known from flow29 (H1 k=3 D -5.1 pp); H2 has never been computed on either year.

data.source: Databento GLBX.MDP3, schema trades, stype_in continuous, symbol CL.v.0 (same as flow29)
data.window: start 2024-10-01, end 2025-10-01 exclusive; monthly chunks raw/CL.v.0_YYYY-MM.dbn.zst, downloaded once
data.side: as flow29: B = buy aggressor, A = sell aggressor, N excluded from the imbalance

code: All bar building, imbalance, trailing thresholds, outcome, roll guard, OANDA alignment and bootstrap are imported from audit/flow29/flow29.py (sha256 55d85d483ce36dadcdb6b81cd7134307cff4203ccb02b592fe3f1183e48f4f85, unchanged). flow42.py adds only the H2 matching and the OANDA spread net.

H1_replication_primary.test: flow29 k=3 test unchanged on 2024-10 .. 2025-10: M5 bars, I_3 = (buy - sell) / (buy + sell) over bars t-2..t, event iff |I_3| >= 95th pct of |I_3| over the previous 20 trading days, first 20 trading days skipped, outcome close[t+6] - close[t] (CL trade prices, gross), ties dropped, every window open and on one contract (no roll), baseline p_up (buy) / 1 - p_up (sell) over all valid bars, D = P(continue | event) - matched baseline, moving-block day bootstrap block 5, 1000 reps, seed 29
H1_replication_primary.pass_rule: PASS iff D < 0 AND the 95% CI upper bound < 0 (direction pre-specified: reversal, as flow29). Also reported: |D| >= 3 pp (the card's display bar), not part of the pass.

H2_incremental_primary.question: Does heavy flow add information beyond the 3-bar price move? Decides whether a live flow feed is worth paying for.
H2_incremental_primary.heavy: the H1 event set (k=3, |I_3| >= trailing 95th pct), restricted to bars with a defined move bin
H2_incremental_primary.move: x = (close[t] - close[t-3]) / ATR(10)[t], signed (raw price direction), bars t-3..t open and on one contract; ATR = flow29.wilder_atr (Wilder, M5 grid, true range reset at a contract change)
H2_incremental_primary.bins: 10 fixed bins per trading day from the deciles of x over all valid bars in the previous 20 trading days (flow29 trailing rule with q = 0.1 .. 0.9, causal); bin = number of edges <= x
H2_incremental_primary.control: bars with a valid outcome window that are not events and have |I_3| < the trailing-20-day median of |I_3| (flow29 trailing rule with q = 0.5), with a defined bin
H2_incremental_primary.cell: (year, move bin, UTC hour of the bar start)
H2_incremental_primary.statistic: D_inc = mean over heavy events with >= 1 control in their cell of (continue - control rate), control rate = control share of up moves in the cell (buy event) or of down moves (sell event). Weighting is by heavy-event count per cell. Heavy events with no control in their cell are dropped and counted.
H2_incremental_primary.windows: y2024 = 2024-10 .. 2025-10 (new), y2025 = 2025-10 .. 2026-10 (flow29 bars), pooled = both years, cells within year. Pooling is allowed because H2 is new on both years; the flow29 year was used to find the H1 effect, so the pooled H2 is not fully independent of that selection.
H2_incremental_primary.inference: flow29 moving-block day bootstrap (validate.day_boot, block 5, 1000 reps, seed 42), control rates recomputed per replicate
H2_incremental_primary.pass_rule: PASS iff pooled D_inc < 0 AND pooled 95% CI upper bound < 0 AND the point estimate D_inc < 0 in y2024 and in y2025 separately

items: OANDA WTICO/USD mid on the same event times (flow29.oanda_rows, history.db read-only)
buy vs sell events (H1 and pooled H2)
fade trade against the flow at OANDA mid, close t to close t+6, net of half the spread at entry and half at exit (bid/ask M1 closes), USD, bps, ATR
H2 heavy-event mean flow-signed x and share in extreme bins
secondary.flow29_run: flow29.run() is executed unchanged on the new bars for the secondary block; its own Holm/3 pp verdict is reported as 'flow29 rule repeat' and does not decide flow42
